claims.claim: SORT achieves MOTA=0.7094, best among all trackers
SparseTrack_3L has higher recall than ByteTrack (0.6321 vs 0.6194)
ID switches increase with more depth layers (4286 to 5857)
Within-layer overlap rate is 3x higher than across-layer (40.6% vs 13.5%)
Detection IoU with ground truth is ~0.8 even for low-score detections
SparseTrack IDF1 is relatively stable across layer counts (0.771-0.774)
No tracker has any mostly lost objects
